'''September 1999 Anderson tournament''' was a sanctioned Star Wars CCG constructed tournament at the Danger Room, a game store in Anderson, Indiana, on 25 September 1999.<ref name="cec-r1">[http://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/reports/report1.html Anderson, In (9/25/99)], Thomas McManus, Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site (GeoCities; OoCities mirror). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20190202030123/http://www.oocities.org:80/collegepark/plaza/9433/reports/report1.html Internet Archive]</ref> Twelve players took part, three of them from West Lafayette who arrived just after the first pairings. [[Chad McCory]], whom [[Steven Horton]] calls the Corellia regional winner, won it.<ref name="cec-r2">[http://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/reports/report2.html Anderson, In (9/25/99)], Steven Horton, Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site (GeoCities; OoCities mirror). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20190202030128/http://www.oocities.org:80/collegepark/plaza/9433/reports/report2.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Date:''' 25 September 1999
* '''Site:''' The Danger Room, Anderson, Indiana
* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Field:''' 12 players, six games<ref name="cec-r1" />
